云遥宇航亮相2026第八届综合能源服务与零碳园区建设大会，荣膺"北极星杯"综合能源服务创新先锋企业

6月25日至26日，由北极星电力网主办的2026第八届综合能源服务与零碳园区建设大会在江苏盐城盛大召开。大会汇聚国家电网、南方电网下属综合能源企业、行业研究机构及众多综合能源服务领军企业，围绕新型电力系统、零碳园区、虚拟电厂、碳市场等热点话题展开深度研讨。作为国内领先的全产业链商业气象数据运营商、国家级重点专精特新"小巨人"企业，天津云遥宇航科技有限公司（以下简称"云遥宇航"）受邀参会，发表主题报告、设立专题展台，并在同期举行的2026年度"北极星杯"综合能源服务影响力评选中，荣膺"综合能源服务创新先锋企业"称号，成为本届该荣誉获评企业中唯一一家商业卫星企业。

### 01 聚焦零碳园区

2026年是"十五五"规划的开局之年，也是零碳园区建设从"试点示范"迈向"规模化推广"的关键节点。在国家"双碳"战略纵深推进的背景下，综合能源服务正成为园区实现绿色低碳转型的核心引擎。本届大会连续两天安排了三十余场主题报告与项目参观，与会嘉宾就源网荷储一体化、绿电供应、电力交易、碳资产管理等议题展开了热烈交流。

![](/media/news/ryjxImg34_260702135116A338.webp)
云遥宇航商业气象卫星专题展台

作为参会企业中独具"空天"特色的代表，云遥宇航的亮相为大会带来了独特的卫星视角。公司自2019年成立于天津港保税区以来，已构建起从卫星载荷整星研制、数据生产到行业应用的完整技术体系，并率先将航天级气象遥感能力下沉应用于新型电力系统与零碳园区建设，受到与会专家的广泛关注。

### 02 空天地一体化赋能

![](/media/news/ryjxImg35_260702135203A339.webp)
云遥宇航气象技术负责人作专题报告

大会期间，云遥宇航气象技术负责人作《高密度商业气象卫星提升新能源电力系统预测能力》的专题报告，从气象卫星与碳卫星的独特视角，系统阐述了空天地一体化技术如何赋能零碳园区建设。

报告指出，云遥宇航目前已成功发射47颗商业气象卫星，正在加快建设由90颗气象卫星和24颗遥感卫星组成的两大星座，可提供12—20分钟级、百米级分辨率的商业气象服务能力，为新型电力系统提供高时空分辨率的环境感知底座。

他表示，随着新能源高比例接入，电力系统的波动性和瞬时性显著增强，对气候环境的精细化感知提出了更高要求。对此，云遥宇航通过将AI气象预测、新能源功率预测与虚拟电厂平台深度耦合，并结合碳卫星动态捕捉空气中的碳足迹，构建起"星地互联"的立体监测网络，预报精度在实际运行中优于行业平均水平，有效破解了综合能源服务中"预测不准、算不清碳、调控粗放"的行业痛点。

面向未来，他提出，零碳园区将逐步演变为"发、储、荷、碳、证、市"协同运营的复杂节点，智能体将成为园区运营者的"贴心秘书"，化繁为简、提质增效，帮助园区构建起可运行、可审计、可复制的零碳园区运营能力。这一前瞻判断，引发了现场嘉宾的广泛共鸣。

### 03 荣膺北极星杯

![](/media/news/ryjxImg36_260702135253A340.webp)
云遥宇航荣膺2026"北极星杯"综合能源服务创新先锋企业

6月25日下午，2026年度"北极星杯"综合能源服务影响力评选颁奖典礼在大会现场隆重举行。该评选由北极星电力网发起，秉持"公平、公正、公开"的原则，旨在表彰在综合能源系统优化、智慧管控及零碳实践中表现卓越的企业，树立行业标杆。经企业申报、专家组评选等环节，云遥宇航凭借"星-地"互联精细化气象数据助力天津市零碳园区智能化建设的创新实践，从众多参评企业中脱颖而出，荣膺2026"北极星杯"综合能源服务创新先锋企业。

![](/media/news/ryjxImg38_260702135324A341.webp)
2026"北极星杯"综合能源服务创新先锋企业奖牌

值得一提的是，在本届获评"创新先锋企业"的名单中，云遥宇航是唯一一家商业卫星企业。这一稀缺性的背后，是公司贯通"卫星研制—星座运营—数据处理—应用服务"全产业链的硬核实力——从卫星载荷自主研制、星座组网发射，到气象数据生产、智能预报与电力行业应用落地，云遥宇航打通了商业航天与能源电力之间的"最后一公里"，以航天级能力反哺新型电力系统，让此次获奖更显含金量与不可替代性。

这一荣誉，是行业对云遥宇航"天基气象感知、智能功率预测、碳电协同调度"差异化技术路线的高度认可。依托自有的高密度商业气象卫星星座资产，云遥宇航以虚拟电厂（VPP）为核心调控手段、以卫星遥感与地面物联网协同感知为底座、以碳资产价值变现为闭环，打造了园区级综合能源服务系统，在技术原创性、商业模式延展性与生态降碳效益上均取得突破性成果。

### 04 卫星赋能引关注

![](/media/news/ryjxImg39_260702135412A342.webp)
云遥宇航展台前，专家同行咨询交流络绎不绝

大会同期，云遥宇航在会场设立专题展台，集中展示了"云遥气象星座"卫星模型、风电功率预测智能管理平台及零碳园区综合解决方案。"建全球气象遥感星座，用精准数据赋能新型电力系统"的展台主题，吸引了众多专家、同行驻足咨询，洽谈交流络绎不绝。

![](/media/news/ryjxImg40_260702135443A343.webp)
会议期间工作人员与来访者积极互动

工作人员现场演示了卫星遥感数据如何与功率预测、虚拟电厂、碳资产管理深度融合，生动呈现了"空天地一体化"在零碳园区场景中的落地价值，让与会者直观感受到商业气象卫星为综合能源服务带来的全新可能。

### 05 结语

从浩瀚星空到零碳园区，云遥宇航正以卫星为"眼"、以AI为"脑"，持续推动航天技术与能源电力的深度融合。公司将加速推动星座组网进度，并持续深化在电力、航海、航空、低空经济等领域的应用。面向"双碳"目标，云遥宇航将以此次获评"综合能源服务创新先锋企业"为新起点，携手行业伙伴，为构建可运行、可审计、可复制的零碳园区运营能力贡献"云遥智慧"，助力新型电力系统建设与绿色低碳高质量发展。

Yunyaoyun Aerospace made its debut at the 8th Comprehensive Energy Services and Zero-Carbon Park Construction Conference in 2026, and was honored as the "Polar Star Cup" Pioneer Enterprise in Comprehensive Energy Services Innovation.
From June 25th to 26th, the 8th Comprehensive Energy Services and Zero-Carbon Park Construction Conference, organized by the Polaris Power Grid, was grandly held in Yancheng, Jiang

From June 25th to 26th, the 8th Comprehensive Energy Services and Zero-Carbon Park Construction Conference, organized by the Polaris Power Grid, was grandly held in Yancheng, Jiangsu Province. The conference brought together enterprises of comprehensive energy services under State Grid and Southern Grid, industry research institutions, and numerous leading enterprises in comprehensive energy services. It conducted in-depth discussions on hot topics such as the new power system, zero-carbon parks, virtual power plants, and carbon markets. As a leading domestic full-chain commercial meteorological data operator and a national-level key specialized "little giant" enterprise, Tianjin Yunyao Yuhang Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Yunyao Yuhang") was invited to attend the conference, delivered a keynote report, set up a special exhibition booth, and won the title of "Innovative Pioneer Enterprise in Comprehensive Energy Services" in the 2026 Annual "Polaris Cup" Comprehensive Energy Services Influence Evaluation, becoming the only commercial satellite enterprise among the enterprises that won this honor in this year.

### I. Focus on Zero-Carbon Parks

2026 is the starting year of the 15th Five Year Plan and a key milestone for the transition of zero carbon park construction from "pilot demonstration" to "large-scale promotion". Against the backdrop of the deepening of the national "dual carbon" strategy, comprehensive energy services are becoming the core engine for parks to achieve green and low-carbon transformation. This conference has arranged more than 30 themed presentations and project visits for two consecutive days, and the attending guests have had lively exchanges on topics such as source grid load storage integration, green power supply, power trading, and carbon asset management.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg34_260702135743A344.webp)
Cloudy Sky Aerospace Commercial Meteorological Satellite Exhibition Stand

As a representative of the participating enterprises with unique "space and aviation" characteristics, Yunyao Aerospace's appearance brought a distinctive satellite perspective to the conference. Since its establishment in Tianjin Port Free Trade Zone in 2019, the company has built a complete technical system covering satellite payload integrated satellite development, data production, and industry application. It was the first to apply the aerospace-level meteorological remote sensing capabilities to the construction of new power systems and zero-carbon parks, attracting widespread attention from the experts present.

### II. Integrated Capability of Air, Land and Space

![](/media/news/ryjxImg35_260702135856A345.webp)
The head of Yunyao Aerospace Meteorological Technology delivered a special report.

During the conference, the person in charge of Yunyao Aerospace Meteorological Technology gave a special report on "Enhancing the Predictive Capability of New Energy Power Systems with High Density Commercial Meteorological Satellites". From the unique perspectives of meteorological satellites and carbon satellites, the report systematically explained how the integration of space, sky, and earth technology can empower the construction of zero carbon parks.

The report points out that Yunyao Aerospace has successfully launched 47 commercial meteorological satellites and is accelerating the construction of two major constellations consisting of 90 meteorological satellites and 24 remote sensing satellites, which can provide commercial meteorological service capabilities with resolutions of 12-20 minutes and 100 meters, and provide a high spatiotemporal resolution environmental perception base for the new power system.

He stated that with the high proportion of new energy integration, the volatility and transience of the power system have significantly increased, posing higher requirements for refined perception of the climate environment. In response, Yunyao Aerospace has deeply coupled AI weather prediction, new energy power prediction, and virtual power plant platform, and combined them with carbon satellites to dynamically capture carbon footprints in the air, building a three-dimensional monitoring network of "satellite ground interconnection". The forecast accuracy is better than the industry average level in actual operation, effectively solving the industry pain points of "inaccurate prediction, unclear carbon calculation, and extensive regulation" in comprehensive energy services.

Looking towards the future, he proposed that zero carbon parks will gradually evolve into complex nodes of "generation, storage, loading, carbon, certification, and city" collaborative operation. Intelligent agents will become the "intimate secretaries" of park operators, simplifying complexity, improving quality and efficiency, and helping parks build operational, auditable, and replicable zero carbon park operation capabilities. This forward-looking judgment has sparked widespread resonance among the guests present.

### III. Won the Polaris Cup

![](/media/news/ryjxImg36_260702140055A346.webp)
Yunyao Aerospace has been awarded the title of "Innovative Pioneer Enterprise in Comprehensive Energy Services" for 2026 by the "Polar Star Cup".

On the afternoon of June 25th, the award ceremony for the 2026 "Polar Star Cup" Comprehensive Energy Service Influence Evaluation was grandly held at the conference venue. This evaluation was initiated by the Polar Star Power Network and adhered to the principles of "fairness, impartiality, and openness", aiming to recognize enterprises that have excelled in optimizing comprehensive energy systems, intelligent management, and zero-carbon practices, and to set industry benchmarks. Through enterprise applications, expert group evaluations, and other stages, Yunyao Aerospace, with its innovative practice of "star-ground" interconnection of refined meteorological data to support the intelligent construction of zero-carbon parks in Tianjin, stood out among the numerous participating enterprises and was honored as the 2026 "Polar Star Cup" Comprehensive Energy Service Innovation Pioneer Enterprise.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg38_260702140140A347.webp)
2026 "Polaris Cup" Award for Innovative Pioneer Enterprise in Comprehensive Energy Services

It is worth noting that among the list of enterprises recognized as "Innovative Pioneer Companies" in this year, Yunyao Aerospace is the only commercial satellite enterprise. This rarity is attributed to the company's core strength that spans the entire industrial chain of "satellite development - constellation operation - data processing - application services" - from the independent development of satellite payloads, constellation networking launch, to the production of meteorological data, intelligent forecasting and the application in the power industry. Yunyao Aerospace has bridged the "last mile" between commercial aerospace and energy and power, leveraging aerospace-level capabilities to support the new power system, making this award even more valuable and irreplaceable. 

This honor is a high recognition from the industry for Yunyao Aerospace's differentiated technical route of "space-based meteorological perception, intelligent power prediction, and carbon-electric coordinated scheduling". Relying on its own high-density commercial meteorological satellite constellation assets, Yunyao Aerospace uses virtual power plant (VPP) as the core control method, integrates satellite remote sensing and ground Internet of Things for coordinated perception as the foundation, and realizes the carbon asset value realization as the closed loop. It has created a park-level comprehensive energy service system, achieving breakthrough results in technological originality, business model extensibility, and ecological carbon reduction benefits.

### IV. Satellite Enabling Drives Attention

![](/media/news/ryjxImg39_260702140315A348.webp)
At the exhibition stand of Yunyao Aerospace, there was a continuous stream of consultations and exchanges among experts.

During the conference, Yunyao Aerospace set up a special exhibition booth at the venue, showcasing the "Cloudy Sky Weather Constellation" satellite model, the intelligent management platform for wind power prediction, and the comprehensive solution for zero-carbon parks. The exhibition booth theme of "Building a global meteorological remote sensing constellation and empowering the new power system with precise data" attracted many experts and colleagues to stop by for consultation, and there was a continuous flow of discussions and negotiations.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg40_260702140355A349.webp)
During the meeting, the staff interacted actively with the visitors.

The staff demonstrated on-site how satellite remote sensing data can be deeply integrated with power prediction, virtual power plants, and carbon asset management. This vividly showcased the practical value of the "space-ground-air integration" in the zero-carbon park scenario, allowing the attendees to directly experience the new possibilities that commercial meteorological satellites bring to integrated energy services.

### V. Conclusion

From the vast expanse of the sky to a zero-carbon park, Yunyao Aerospace is leveraging satellites as "eyes" and AI as "brains" to continuously promote the deep integration of aerospace technology and energy and power. The company will accelerate the progress of constellation networking and continuously deepen its applications in the fields of power, navigation, aviation, and low-altitude economy. In line with the "dual carbon" goals, Yunyao Aerospace, with this recognition as an "innovative pioneer enterprise in comprehensive energy service", will take this as a new starting point and collaborate with industry partners to contribute "Yunyao wisdom" to building a zero-carbon park operation capability that is operational, auditable, and replicable. This will also help in the construction of a new power system and the high-quality green development.
